title: Beca Generación Bicentenario (Convocatoria extraordinaria 2026)
official_source: PRONABEC - Programa Nacional de Becas y Crédito Educativo, Ministerio de Educación del Perú
duration: Programme of studies abroad must start between 2026-07-01 and 2027-12-31; no benefits are recognised for study time already completed
description: PRONABEC, Peru's National Scholarships and Educational Credit Programme, offers 20 integral scholarships for Peruvian professionals with high academic performance and insufficient resources to study a master's or doctorate abroad and turn their knowledge into development opportunities for Peru, with no age limit.

title: Programa de patrocinios del Banco de la República para estudios de posgrado en el exterior
official_source: Banco de la República (Central Bank of Colombia)
duration: Doctoral sponsorship runs up to a maximum of the fourth year of the overseas programme; the economic-law patronage covers a master's or doctorate up to the second or fourth year according to the programme
description: The Banco de la República sponsors postgraduate study at foreign institutions of recognised academic excellence for Colombian professionals, and the programme is organised by discipline rather than as one open call. The lines named on the official programme page are doctoral study in economics, master's degrees in public administration and public policy, a postgraduate qualification in economic law, and patronage of individual young talent in plastic arts and in music. title: Beca de la Escuela Doctoral Franco-Peruana en Ciencias de la Ingeniería y Geociencias (EDFPCIG) - Convocatoria 2026
official_source: Escuela Doctoral Franco-Peruana en Ciencias de la Ingeniería y Geociencias (EDFPCIG), administrada por la Escuela de Posgrado de la PUCP
duration: Three years (36 months): year 1 doctoral thesis at PUCP, year 2 one-year research stay at a French partner university of the IRD joint unit, year 3 doctoral thesis at PUCP
description: The EDFPCIG is a research structure for doctoral training bringing together Peruvian and French researchers, funded by the Embassy of France in Peru, IRD and PUCP; the 2026 call awards one doctoral scholarship alternating between PUCP in Lima and a French partner university.

title: Becas Colombia Biodiversa - Fondo de Becas Colombia Biodiversa, Convocatoria II-2026
duration: Undergraduates have a maximum of one year and master's students two years from the award to complete the research
description: The Fundación Alejandro Ángel Escobar's Colombia Biodiversa Fund supports undergraduate and master's students with research grants for degree theses on the knowledge, conservation or sustainable use of Colombian biodiversity, across all areas of knowledge.

title: Beca Interna Postdoctoral - Convocatoria Becas 2026 (CONICET)
official_source: CONICET - Consejo Nacional de Investigaciones Científicas y Técnicas, Argentina
description: CONICET's 2026 call provides 800 internal postdoctoral fellowships for candidates who have completed and defended their doctorate and wish to develop research in Argentina, with 36-month fellowships starting 1 August 2027.

title: Programa de Becas de Cooperación Sur Sur - República de Chile, Convocatoria Año 2027 (AGCID)
official_source: Agencia Chilena de Cooperación Internacional para el Desarrollo (AGCID), Government of Chile
duration: Up to a maximum of 24 months; studies start between 1 March and 30 September 2027 (programme dates published as 03-03-2027 to 28-02-2029)
description: AGCID, Chile's international cooperation agency, runs a South-South cooperation scholarship programme under which professionals from Latin America and the Caribbean study a master's degree at accredited Chilean universities with a high level of excellence. The 2027 call is aimed at degree-holding professionals working in government programmes or ministries and public services, as well as university academic staff, teachers and researchers, and also at professionals working in civil society across the invited countries. title: PEC-PG - Brazilian Program for Exchange Students, Postgraduate Level (PEC-PG 2027)
official_source: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Brazil (Itamaraty) with Conselho Nacional de Desenvolvimento Cientifico e Tecnologico (CNPq)
program_type: Government scholarship (Brazilian postgraduate exchange programme run by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs with CNPq)
duration: 24 months for a master's; 48 months for a doctorate
description: PEC-PG is the Brazilian postgraduate exchange programme funded by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and administered through CNPq, open to nationals of participating countries who are not Brazilian and do not hold Brazilian permanent residence. For the 2027 cycle the Call Notice was released on 29 June 2026 and CNPq publishes the list of eligible Brazilian institutions in December 2026, after which each institution runs its own candidate selection.
